master.headline: Infrastructure for AI agents that must keep context and evidence inside the boundary.
master.lead: Perseus Computing LLC builds the system around the model: live context before an agent acts, governed memory after it acts, and evidence for the decisions that matter. It runs locally, including in disconnected and regulated environments where cloud memory and opaque state are not acceptable.
master.why_body: AI can produce a plausible answer while losing the state that made it useful. Perseus keeps current context, governed memory, and a reviewable record in the same boundary as the workflow.
master.discussion: Start with a bounded workflow, its data boundary, and the integration surface that needs to be made reviewable.
fit_rows: CYBER & NETWORKS
AI/ML, DevSecOps, cyber, and enterprise IT workflows where context and evidence must stay inside the controlled network.
C3BM
Software factories and distributed decision workflows; enabling infrastructure, not a claim to own the mission platform.
ELECTRONIC SYSTEMS
Partner-led support where local, reviewable AI connects to sensing, EW, PNT, or mission-system workflows.

cyber-networks.headline: AI-assisted cyber workflows need more than a model.
cyber-networks.lead: Perseus keeps the working context, governed memory, and evidence trail inside the controlled environment where the workflow runs.
cyber-networks.why_body: For AI/ML, DevSecOps, and enterprise cyber workflows, the failure mode is often context loss: an agent cannot see the current repository, ticket, deployment, or prior decision, and the next operator cannot reconstruct what happened. Perseus supplies that layer locally.
cyber-networks.discussion: A bounded cyber or DevSecOps workflow, its data boundary, and the integration surface between the agent, tools, and existing systems.
fit_rows: AI/ML
Context and memory for controlled model-assisted workflows.
DEVSECOPS
State and evidence across repositories, tickets, deployments, and handoffs.
CYBER / IT
Local deployment where cloud memory, telemetry, or opaque state is out of bounds.

c3bm.headline: Software-factory agents need memory that survives the handoff.
c3bm.lead: Perseus gives AI-enabled C2 and software-factory workflows a local context and evidence layer without claiming to be the mission platform.
c3bm.why_body: Distributed teams and agents move through repositories, decisions, and operational artifacts. When state disappears between sessions, software-factory work becomes harder to review, re-plan, and trust. Perseus keeps the context and provenance available at the boundary where the work is done.
c3bm.discussion: A software-factory or distributed decision workflow, the context handoffs that fail today, and the existing integration surface.
fit_rows: SOFTWARE FACTORIES
Durable context across agent sessions, repositories, tickets, and engineering handoffs.
C2 / DECISION
Evidence-backed memory for workflows that must be re-planned and reviewed.
PARTNER BOUNDARY
An enabling layer that can sit beside the mission platform, not a claim to replace it.

electronic-systems.headline: Local AI support for mission-system workflows.
electronic-systems.lead: Perseus provides the context, governed memory, and evidence layer around an AI system; sensing, EW, PNT, and mission-system integration remains a partner-led conversation.
electronic-systems.why_body: Mission-system teams need to know what data an AI assistant saw, what it retained, and how a decision can be reviewed without moving the working record outside the program boundary. Perseus is the local infrastructure for that record.
electronic-systems.discussion: A specific sensing, EW, PNT, or mission-system integration boundary, its deployment constraints, and the prime or partner role.
